name: size
description: Size of the input field. Default: 'medium'.

name: rounded
description: Corner radius (small, medium, large — 'large' is a full pill). In the game theme the pixel frame's corners are stepped instead: square, one-step notch, two-step. Default: 'medium'.

name: variant
description: Visual style. 'outline' is the default bordered input; 'filled' uses a filled background, useful when the field needs to stand out from other form elements. Default: 'outline'.

name: status
description: Validation state — changes border and helper text color. Use 'error' with `helperText` set to a clear message explaining what went wrong; use 'success' with `helperText` to confirm validation passed. Default: 'default'.

name: label
description: Label text rendered above the input.

name: helperText
description: Helper text rendered below the input. When `status` is 'error', this renders as the error message instead of the default helper text.

name: validate
type: (value: unknown, formValues: Record<string, unknown>) => string | string[] | Promise<string | string[] | null> | null
